description: One setting per call on a connection: method and pattern request one more rule (pending approval); lock: true ends its learning (pending approval: the rules drawn from the observed calls apply, the rest is refused); caller, window and calls set a call limit; remove_limit removes a limit.

approve_each_call.description: true: each call waits for an approval.

calls.description: The number of calls allowed per window.

reason.description: Why this rule, in one sentence.

remove_limit.description: The limit to remove (its id, list_connections { view: "limits" }).
